Strategy: Refine worst fit with a spread trigger and sliver penalty: use worst fit when the spread is at least half the item size, otherwise Best Fit with a penalty for leftovers below item/4, plus an exact-fit bonus. The choice differs from Best Fit when the spread is wide and no exact fit exists, since the loosest bin wins, and when the sliver penalty flips two bins. Over-spreading is possible, but the penalty protects fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    spread = max(bins) - min(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if spread >= item / 2 else -(r - item) - (30 if 0 < r - item < item / 4 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
